name: heyhuman
description: Your AI is waiting. Permission required. Audible alerts when AI coding agents need your approval.

heyhuman.enabled.description: Master switch to enable or disable HeyHuman alerts.

heyhuman.agents.copilot.enabled.description: Enable alerts for GitHub Copilot permission prompts.

heyhuman.agents.antigravity.enabled.description: Enable alerts for Google Antigravity permission prompts.

heyhuman.agents.claude.enabled.description: Enable alerts for Claude Code permission prompts.

heyhuman.agents.cursor.enabled.description: Enable alerts for Cursor Agent confirmation prompts.

heyhuman.agents.aider.enabled.description: Enable alerts for Aider confirmation prompts.

heyhuman.sound.enabled.description: Play an audible alert when a permission request is detected.

heyhuman.sound.customSoundPath.description: Optional absolute path to a custom sound file (.wav, .mp3, .aiff).

heyhuman.notifications.enabled.description: Display a notification message when permission is required.

heyhuman.notifications.focusWindowOnClic.description: Attempt to bring window to focus when notification is clicked.

heyhuman.alerts.cooldownSeconds.description: Minimum seconds between consecutive alerts to prevent alarm spam.

heyhuman.alerts.temporaryMuteDurationMin.description: Duration in minutes when temporarily muting alerts.

heyhuman.antigravity.customLogPath.description: Custom path or directory for Antigravity transcripts (leave empty for auto-detection).

heyhuman.antigravity.companionPort.description: Local port for HeyHuman companion IPC bridge (for external Antigravity sessions).

heyhuman.copilot.customLogPath.description: Custom path for Copilot chat transcripts or logs (leave empty for auto-detection).

heyhuman.webRoom.description: Optional HeyHuman Web App Room ID (e.g. 'akdey'). Broadcasts alerts to your mobile phone via PWA/Vercel.

heyhuman.webEndpoint.description: URL of the HeyHuman web application (defaults to https://hey-human-akdey.vercel.app).
